selection: fixed 1D6R coefficient pair; independently select one of nine measured direction/QB-order configurations at each error bound; no coefficient is removed before selection
flat_reference_policy: expand the symmetric error-bound index neighborhood until its averaged endpoints differ, only for a fully flat original reference with unequal current candidate bit rates; still reject a fully flat dataset or nonmonotone expanded reference
curves: one fixed coefficient pair per curve; exact selected measured coordinates, connected in error-bound order; no smoothing, markers, coordinate jitter or synthesized endpoints
best_per_error_bound: dashed curve may change coefficient pair; it is not another fixed-coefficient setting or an interpolated envelope
detail: the same complete curves, clipped to a view containing the last two quintic and best-per-bound observations; no new measurement or reselection
style_encoding: fixed quintic: red solid; best per error bound: black dashed; all other coefficient pairs: identical light-gray thin solid
